chunks: Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام was asked about a man who falls asleep while sitting: is wudu (ablution) required of him?
He said: “No wudu (ablution) is required of him so long as he remains seated and does not slump apart.”

key_terms.مَا دَامَ: so long as or as long as
key_terms.وُضُوءٌ: ritual ablution required for acts of worship
key_terms.يَرْقُدُ: falls asleep or lies in sleep
key_terms.يَنْفَرِجْ: becomes parted, loosened, or slumps open

ai.seo_question: Does falling asleep while sitting invalidate wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about sleep and wudu (ablution). It indicates that sleeping while seated does not invalidate wudu as long as the person remains in a stable seated position and does not become loosened or slump over.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.144 - Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) was asked about a man who falls asleep while sitting: does he need to perform ablution?
Imam (as) said: 'He does not need to perform ablution as long as he remains seated and does not slump over.'.
